lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a faint checkered pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with light pixels on the dorsal side and deep shadow immediately ventral to the ridge.
